```csv
sensor_family,historical_role,mean_shapley_mae_value,verdict,reason
PRICE,CONFIRMATION_BASELINE,-0.0004085883380799,RETAIN_CORE,Price is the baseline structure.
BTCD,SURVIVAL_CONTEXT,-0.0030193882677858,ZERO_PREDICTIVE_WEIGHT_RETAIN_CONTEXT,Negative or unstable incremental OOS value.
STABLE,LIQUIDITY_ACTIVITY_CONTEXT,2.901554123703313e-05,RETAIN_CONTEXT_ONLY,Small 7-14d value but latency/regime fragility blocks action authority.
C2,LEAN_WARNING,,EXPAND_FORWARD_ROWS,Best frequency-matched timing survivor; sample remains one-cycle.
A3,URGENCY_SHADOW,,QUARANTINE_ZERO_WEIGHT,High false-alarm density and poor marginal precision.
D_FAMILY,CONFIRMATION_VETO,,RETAIN_NARROW_ROLE,Clean but late; useful as confirmation rather than prediction.
LEGACY_ALT_PHASE,BREADTH_PROXY,,REJECT_AS_BREADTH_SUBSTITUTE,Categorical phase labels do not create point-in-time participation breadth.
FROZEN_BREADTH,PARTICIPATION_CONFIRMATION,-0.0171843905531793,RETAIN_DESCRIPTIVE_CONFIRMATION_ZERO_PREDICTIVE_WEIGHT,"Point-in-time breadth is a valid independent participation truth layer, but worsened OOS magnitude prediction across all horizons; any directional benefit was small and unstable.
```
